name: Chicken Bog II
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Put water, salt, onion, and chicken in pot. Boil until tender (about 1 hour).
Remove chicken, let cool, and remove bones.
Skim off fat from juices. Measure 3 ½ cups of this broth into a 6-quart saucepan. Add rice, chicken pieces and smoked sausage, herb seasoning and "chicken and herb" seasoning.
Cook these ingredients for 30 minutes. Bring to a boil and reduce heat and simmer, keeping covered the entire time. If rice mixture is too wet, cook uncovered until desired consistency.
